title: Unsafe deserialization / model loading

patterns.message: pickle.load executes arbitrary code on load (CWE-502).
dill.load executes arbitrary code on load.
torch.load without weights_only=True can execute code (CVE-2025-32434).
yaml.load without SafeLoader can execute code.
trust_remote_code=True runs arbitrary model repo code.

remediation: Use safe loaders: torch.load(weights_only=True), yaml.safe_load, safetensors; never unpickle untrusted artifacts; pin + verify model provenance.
